info.description:
Identity and account management for IVCAP: accounts, projects, membership, invitations and capabilities.

## Authentication

Every endpoint except the JWKS and the capability vocabulary takes an access token in
the Authorization header:

    Authorization: Bearer ivcap_at_…

Access tokens are opaque and short-lived. Obtain one, with a refresh token, from `/oauth2/token`:

- **Browser apps**: the authorization code flow with PKCE, starting at `/oauth2/auth`.
- **The IVCAP CLI and other headless tools**: the device authorization flow, starting at `/oauth2/device/auth`.

The OpenID Connect discovery document at `/.well-known/openid-configuration` lists every endpoint.
